headline.one_liner: Nothing is running yet. A 600 MW campus filed under a codename is 2.4 miles away and the county votes on 5 November.

on_your_grid.summary: No data-center facility is live within five miles. One campus is announced 3.9 km west under the name Project Tembo. The county planning packet identifies the applicant as Calder Hyperscale.

sources.title: County planning packet (fictional)
sources.quote: The applicant, identified in filings as Project Tembo, is a subsidiary of Calder Hyperscale Inc.

coming.summary: About 140 acres of farmland at the announced site has been graded flat between the 2023 and 2025 imagery. No roofs yet.
coming.gap: Graded land is not a roof. Footprint is 0 until buildings appear.

your_bill.summary: Your state's residential price rose 6.1% over 24 months, about $10 more per month for a typical home. No regulator statement attributes any of it to data centers yet.

sources.title: State residential price series (fictional)
sources.quote: Average residential price, WI, Aug 2026: 17.4 c/kWh

protection.summary: Not yet. A large-load tariff has been proposed but not approved. Until it is, the new load is served under the general tariff and nothing in the rules keeps its grid costs off your bill.

hearing.summary: The County Board takes public comment on the water agreement on 5 November. At the 7 October meeting the chair confirmed the comment session; a resident asked who the applicant was and was not answered.

sources.title: County Board meeting archive, 7 Oct 2026 (fictional)
sources.quote: We will take public comment on the water agreement at the November 5 session
